sources.verifiedBy: read from the stored copy in watcher/state/snapshots/mo-a8348dd409.txt.gz: the MO-941 requirement, MyTax Missouri, the timely compensation deduction, the electronic mandate for quarter-monthly filers, and the pointer to a list of due dates for all filing frequencies (not stored).

epay.text: The Director of Revenue has mandated that effective January 1, 2004, all employers subject to the requirement of quarter-monthly filing must file and pay withholding tax electronically.

notModelled: Form MO-941 (Employer's Withholding Tax Income Return) is required for every period even with no withholding, filed through MyTax Missouri; its due dates are on a list that is not stored, so none is recorded.

Missouri's filing frequencies (quarter-monthly, monthly, quarterly, annual) and every payment due date: the FAQ says 'click here for a current list of due dates for all filing frequencies', which is not in the stored documents, so no deposit schedule is computed.

The timely compensation deduction an employer may take when MO-941 is filed and paid on time: 2% of withholding up to $5,000 of year-to-date tax, 1% from $5,001 to $10,000, 1/2% over $10,000 (not applied here).
Missouri unemployment insurance (Division of Employment Security): no document read.
St. Louis and Kansas City earnings taxes: separate agencies, not modelled.

channels.description: MyTax Missouri portal (registered or guest filing); quarter-monthly filers must file and pay electronically
enrollment: Register for a Missouri withholding account (steps not read); MyTax Missouri registration needs the Missouri Tax Identification Number (MOID) and a Personal Identification Number (PIN), or file as a guest.
A professional employer organization co-employing workers affects account closure; see the FAQ.
